macros.name: labday
macros.doc: \labday is an extended \addchap (i.e. an un-numbered \chapter with toc entry and assignment of a running headline) which additionally sets the closing index entry for the preceding \(sub)experiment.

macros.name: subexperiment
macros.doc: Below \experiment you can use \subexperiment which works in the same way and produces sub-indexentries. It is intended for sections like “design, realization, evaluation” or “preparation, purification, measurement”.
